findings.title: AIS simulation retrieves 50 unfiltered global incidents alongside rule-matched incidents (50 + 2 = 52) and omits event_type fallback
findings.observed_behavior: AIS G8 simulation scanned 52 incidents (50 RULE_MISMATCH + 2 RULE_MATCHED) when evaluating PH_RULE_HEAVY_TCP_HOST_SCAN.
findings.expected_behavior: AIS rule simulation should retrieve exclusively incidents belonging to the target canonical rule (matching either FK rule_id or canonical event_type) without injecting unrelated rules or truncating >50-incident cohorts.
findings.root_cause_or_hypothesis: PolicySimulationService.evaluate_candidate_policy hardcodes sample_limit=50; run_dry_run_intelligence_evaluation executes an unfiltered global top-50 query (scanned_q) plus a rule-filtered query (matched_q using Incident.rule_id.in_(rule_ids) without event_type) and merges matched_rows + scanned_rows.
findings.db_or_runtime_evidence: Local DB run e95d8a8e-b1d6-4178-95e3-136df7d32a09 for PH_RULE_HEAVY_TCP_HOST_SCAN_ON_FIXED_PORT (0 local incidents) scanned all 26 unrelated local incidents; run 645aa5c8 scanned 26 (6 matched + 20 RULE_MISMATCH).
findings.recommended_remediation: Remove global scanned_q when rule_id is supplied; filter matched_q on or_(Incident.rule_id.in_(rule_ids), Incident.event_type == matched_rule.event_type); raise/paginate retrieval limit cleanly prioritizing labeled closed cases.
verification_steps: Run live PostgreSQL reconciliation SQL to verify exact target-rule vs global top-50 overlap.
Add unit test asserting total_scanned == rule_matched when rule_id is provided.

findings.title: AIS G8 simulation defaults to mocked SIMULATED provider and never invokes live local LLM
findings.observed_behavior: Clicking Run Simulation in AIS executes heuristic _simulate_model_output with zero NETWORK_SCAN rules, proposing REQUIRES_ATTENTION (50%) on scan incidents without calling Qwen LLM.
findings.expected_behavior: Empirical validation (G8) should execute real inference against the configured local LLM (or block empirical G8 certification whenever provider_type is SIMULATED).
findings.root_cause_or_hypothesis: evaluate_candidate_policy omits provider_type in its call to run_dry_run_intelligence_evaluation (which defaults provider_type='SIMULATED'). _simulate_model_output only inspects sentBytes64, command_line, and backup/maintenance strings.
findings.db_or_runtime_evidence: All 9 historical_evaluation_runs in backend/ai_verdict.db record config_snapshot.provider_type = 'SIMULATED'.
findings.recommended_remediation: Expose provider selection in AIS G8 (defaulting to OPENAI_COMPATIBLE when Server 2 is online via async queue) and forbid is_simulated=True runs from earning G8 EVALUATED_PASSED (15/15).
verification_steps: Execute controlled simulation with OPENAI_COMPATIBLE enabled against online LLM and inspect historical_evaluation_results.claims_summary.is_simulated=false and token_usage_records.

findings.title: Structural approval activates policy into live SOC triage despite G8 INSUFFICIENT_DATA
findings.observed_behavior: PH_RULE_HEAVY_TCP_HOST_SCAN achieved status APPROVED (approval_eligible=true, empirical_validation_eligible=false), and live VerdictTriageAgent runs on any status='APPROVED' policy.
findings.expected_behavior: Policies lacking empirical G8 certification (autonomous_operation_eligible=false) must remain strictly advisory/shadow or gated from autonomous production decisions.
findings.root_cause_or_hypothesis: G8 INSUFFICIENT_DATA returns GateStatus.WARNING (non-blocking), PolicyQualityValidator sets approval_eligible = (len(blocking_issues) == 0), AgentPolicyEngine.approve_version gates only on approval_eligible, and VerdictTriageAgent checks only candidate.status == 'APPROVED'.
findings.db_or_runtime_evidence: Confirmed in prompts.py:461-463 and quality-export.test.mjs:122-126 (approval_eligible=true, empirical_validation_eligible=false, autonomous_operation_eligible=false).
findings.recommended_remediation: Persist autonomous_operation_eligible on PromptVersion/PolicyQualityAssessmentRecord and enforce analyst-review/advisory cap in VerdictTriageAgent whenever G8 != EVALUATED_PASSED.
verification_steps: Verify unit test confirms policies approved with G8=INSUFFICIENT_DATA cannot issue unchecked autonomous decisive verdicts.

findings.title: Ground truth ML substring false-positives and boilerplate overriding human attribution
findings.observed_behavior: Valid analyst-cleared incidents are classified as is_ml_generated=True / HEURISTIC_OR_ML_LABEL if comments contain substring 'ml' or FortiSIEM retains 'Resolution set by Machine Learning'.
findings.expected_behavior: Only unverified automated/ML closures without subsequent human analyst adjudication should be excluded as HEURISTIC_OR_ML_LABEL.
findings.root_cause_or_hypothesis: ingestion_service.py:639 checks '"ml" in comments.lower()' (matching normal/html/xml/similar); fortisiem_service.py:1145 checks '"ML" in comments' (matching HTML/XML); _is_automated_resolution_text returns True on is_ml_generated without checking human cleared_user or cleared_reason overrides.
findings.db_or_runtime_evidence: In backend/ai_verdict.db, 13 of 24 historical_ground_truth rows have is_ml_generated=1, including 132501348 (Manually Cleared, cleared_user='Yash Mungekar', comment contains both ML prefix and analyst narrative) and 132461358 (cleared_user='shivamw', cleared_reason='hash value is clean').
findings.recommended_remediation: Use word-boundary regex r'\bml\b' and recognize explicit human cleared_user / substantive human cleared_reason overrides as human-adjudicated ground truth.
verification_steps: Query live PostgreSQL historical_ground_truth rows with is_ml_generated=true and cleared_user <> '' to quantify recoverable human cases.

findings.title: G1-G8 weight denominator mismatch (85 vs 105) and impossibility of 91/105 with 95.3%
findings.observed_behavior: Quality summary shows Overall=81, Structural=95.3%, G8=0/15, while report mentions G1-G7 awarded points 91/105 despite code yielding 101/105.
findings.expected_behavior: Gate max_score sums across G1-G7 (85) + G8 (15) should equal Overall 100 without double-counting detection_semantics.
findings.root_cause_or_hypothesis: PolicyQualityValidator assigns max_score=20 to BOTH G1 and G2 while folding both into single 20-pt score_breakdown['detection_semantics'] (G1-G7 max_score sum = 105; structural_raw denom = 85; 81/85 = 95.3%). With structural_raw=81 and G2=20, sum(G1..G7) is algebraically 101/105 (verified in quality-export.test.mjs:24-116). The 91/105 figure likely reflects either omitting G7=10 during manual summation (16+20+20+10+10+15=91) or a legacy pre-9616971 snapshot (UNVERIFIED).
findings.db_or_runtime_evidence: Confirmed algebraically in PolicyQualityValidator and verified via passing node test quality-export.test.mjs.
findings.recommended_remediation: Allocate distinct non-overlapping weights (e.g., G1=10, G2=10, G3=20, G4=10, G5=10, G6=15, G7=10, G8=15; total=100).
verification_steps: Inspect live exported quality_gates JSON from remote Studio UI to confirm exact G1..G7 per-gate scores.

findings.title: Exported G1-G8 JSON always serializes validation_status as null
findings.observed_behavior: Quality Gates export payload contains assessment.validation_status: null.
findings.expected_behavior: Exported status field should reflect a populated validation state (or remove redundant null field in favor of empirical_validation_status).
findings.root_cause_or_hypothesis: PolicyQualityAssessmentResponse Pydantic schema omits validation_status and uses empirical_validation_status/simulation_status, whereas frontend/src/lib/qualityExport.ts:170 accesses assessment.validation_status || null.
findings.db_or_runtime_evidence: Verified in quality-export.test.mjs and schema inspection.
findings.recommended_remediation: Map validation_status in qualityExport.ts from empirical_validation_status (or remove deprecated null field consistently across consumers).
verification_steps: Update qualityExport.ts and assert non-null validation_status in quality-export.test.mjs.

findings.title: AI Triage Workbench search merges distinct similarly named TCP scan rules (33 vs 2)
findings.observed_behavior: Searching 'Heavy TCP Host Scan' in AI Triage Workbench returns 33 incidents while AIS exact rule simulation matches 2.
findings.expected_behavior: Users should be warned that free-text search aggregates multiple canonical rules and have clear rule_id filtering badges to distinguish PH_RULE_HEAVY_TCP_HOST_SCAN from PH_RULE_HEAVY_TCP_HOST_SCAN_ON_FIXED_PORT.
findings.root_cause_or_hypothesis: IncidentService.list_incidents applies ILIKE '%term%' across 6 columns (incident_id, title, description, source_ip, reporting_device, event_type), combining multiple sibling scan rules.
findings.db_or_runtime_evidence: Confirmed in backend/app/services/incident_service.py; exact 33-row live distribution across rules is UNVERIFIED remotely.
findings.recommended_remediation: Display canonical rule_id badges on Workbench search results and add quick-filter chips by exact canonical rule.
verification_steps: Run live Workbench ILIKE reconciliation SQL grouped by Rules.rule_id and Incident.event_type.

findings.title: Inconsistent canonical rule UUID vs rule_id lookups, REST 500-incident rule discovery, and Pattern Conditions parser bug
findings.observed_behavior: Different modules resolve Rule rows inconsistently, REST rule sync only inspects newest 500 alerts, and RuleParser drops 'Pattern Conditions' headings.
findings.expected_behavior: All services should accept UUID, logical rule_id, and event_type consistently; authoritative rule parsing should preserve 'Pattern Conditions' text.
findings.root_cause_or_hypothesis: AgentPolicyEngine (6 methods) and RuleMaturityService query Rule.id == rule_id only; rules.list_rules ignores event_type unlike rules.get_rule_detail; sync_all_rules_from_siem relies on /pub/incident size=500; rule_parser.py:112-115 ignores sections['pattern conditions'].
findings.db_or_runtime_evidence: Confirmed via code reading and test_rule_parser.py; live unlinked incident count UNVERIFIED.
findings.recommended_remediation: Standardize centralized rule resolution helper and include sections['pattern conditions'] in DetectionContextEngine.
verification_steps: Add unit test parsing rule text containing 'Pattern Conditions' header and verify pattern_logic is populated.

findings.title: AIS G8 diverges from Live Triage safeguards, ignores Investigation.is_disputed, and still runs inference on excluded rows
findings.observed_behavior: Even with OPENAI_COMPATIBLE, AIS G8 bypasses Preflight, RAG, TokenBudget, IndependentVerdictValidator, RuleIntelligenceSnapshot, Investigation.is_disputed, and evaluates excluded RULE_MATCHED incidents.
findings.expected_behavior: Simulation should run the identical compiled-policy + validation stack as live triage, respect disputed flags, and skip excluded rows before inference.
findings.root_cause_or_hypothesis: PolicySimulationService uses a bespoke loop without Preflight/RAG/Budget/IndependentVerdictValidator/Snapshot, never joins Investigation.is_disputed (unlike HistoricalEligibilityService:185), and lacks 'continue' after setting exclusion_reason at lines 581-590.
findings.db_or_runtime_evidence: Local DB run 645aa5c8 shows evaluated_cases=6 while verified_ground_truth_cases=2 (all 4 excluded DEBUG incidents still evaluated and stored in historical_evaluation_results).
findings.recommended_remediation: Consolidate shared evaluation pipeline for Live + Simulation, enforce disputed exclusion, and add 'continue' when exclusion_reason is set.
verification_steps: Run test_live_simulation_parity.py and new test verifying excluded rows do not produce HistoricalEvaluationResultRecord evaluations.

findings.title: NETWORK_SCAN telemetry normalization omits Destination Port aliases; Contract ignores Snapshot; Archetype typo
findings.observed_behavior: 'Destination Port' / 'dstPort' / 'destinationPort' fields are omitted during canonical normalization; EvidenceContractService ignores RuleIntelligenceSnapshot.
findings.expected_behavior: All standard FortiSIEM destination port attribute variants should normalize to network.destination_port and contracts should incorporate snapshot-verified rule thresholds.
findings.root_cause_or_hypothesis: FIELD_MAPPINGS maps only 'destport'/'dest_port', fallback ignores 'port', EvidenceSufficiencyEngine._match_field has no port alias group, rawEvents is skipped when attributes/event exist, EvidenceContractService calls analyze_rule without snapshot, and detection_archetype_registry.py:691 has typo PH_RULE_HEAVY_TCP_HOST_SCAN_FIXED_PORT.
findings.db_or_runtime_evidence: Confirmed by inspection of normalization, sufficiency, contract, and archetype modules.
findings.recommended_remediation: Add destination port aliases across normalization/sufficiency, handle rawEvents deterministically, wire RuleIntelligenceSnapshot into EvidenceContractService, and fix line 691 typo.
verification_steps: Unit test NETWORK_SCAN incident carrying 'Destination Port' and 'dstPort' attributes -> verify network.destination_port extracted and SUFFICIENT.

findings.title: Fragmented simulation subsystems (AIS G8 vs Legacy Dry-Run Lab & Maturity) and hardcoded SIMULATED UI launch
findings.observed_behavior: Legacy /dry-run and RuleMaturityService maintain separate tables/approval logic unrelated to AIS G8, while Verdict Intelligence dashboard launch hardcodes provider_type='SIMULATED'.
findings.expected_behavior: Single canonical simulation & maturity engine with explicit execution provider control.
findings.root_cause_or_hypothesis: Parallel phase evolution left dry_run_service.py / maturity_service.py separate from policy_simulation_service.py; verdict-intelligence/page.tsx:162 hardcodes SIMULATED.
findings.db_or_runtime_evidence: Local SQLite shows dry_run_jobs=0, dry_run_results=0, rule_maturity_evaluations=0 alongside historical_evaluation_runs=9, historical_evaluation_results=62.
findings.recommended_remediation: Deprecate or unify legacy DryRun / RuleMaturity tables into AIS G8 historical_evaluation_runs and expose provider_type selector.
verification_steps: Confirm unified evaluation table reflects both Studio and Intelligence dashboard runs.

findings.title: Local environment fallback configuration, synchronous simulation execution, and .env append hygiene
findings.observed_behavior: Local backend/.env enables LOCAL_LLM_ALLOW_MOCK_FALLBACK=true and FORTISIEM_MOCK_FALLBACK=true, omits DATABASE_URL/SECRET_KEY/AUDIT_SIGNING_KEY, contains repeated appended headers from llm_config_service, and G8 simulation runs synchronously on web workers.
findings.expected_behavior: Strict production config enforcement, clean idempotent .env updates, and Celery simulation_replay background execution for real LLM G8 batches.
findings.root_cause_or_hypothesis: backend/.env holds dev overrides; prompts.py:553 awaits evaluate_candidate_policy inline rather than dispatching to Celery queue simulation_replay; llm_config_service appends config sections.
findings.db_or_runtime_evidence: Direct inspection of backend/.env (129 lines, masked), config.py, and deployment/env.production.example.
findings.recommended_remediation: Enforce non-mock env flags in staging/prod, dispatch live-LLM G8 simulations to Celery simulation_replay worker, and update .env keys cleanly in place.
verification_steps: Verify production /api/health reports healthy PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, and Local LLM without mock fallback.

findings.title: Remote PostgreSQL exact counts (34 rules / 2,900+ incidents / 33 vs 2 vs 1 breakdown) require live SQL execution

findings.expected_behavior: Live production SQL counts should reconcile 100% with AIS G8 funnel diagnostics and Workbench search output.
findings.root_cause_or_hypothesis: Production PostgreSQL database, FortiSIEM Supervisor, and Server 2 vLLM are inaccessible from the local audit workspace.
findings.db_or_runtime_evidence: Confirmed absent from local backend/ai_verdict.db; requires remote read-only SQL verification.
findings.recommended_remediation: Execute the documented read-only SQL queries on live Server 1 PostgreSQL and attach results to close AIS-F13.
verification_steps: Run the SQL diagnostics in AIS_INCIDENT_RETRIEVAL_AUDIT.md, AIS_RULE_MAPPING_AUDIT.md, and AIS_GROUND_TRUTH_AUDIT.md against production PostgreSQL.

live_verification_sql_queries.reconcile_totals: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rules) AS total_rules, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incidents) AS total_incidents, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM historical_ground_truth) AS total_gt_rows;
live_verification_sql_queries.reconcile_workbench_33: SELECT COALESCE(r.rule_id, 'UNLINKED_RULE_FK') AS linked_canonical_rule, i.rule_id AS incident_rule_fk, i.event_type AS incident_event_type, COUNT(*) AS incident_count FROM incidents i LEFT JOIN rules r ON r.id = i.rule_id WHERE i.incident_id ILIKE '%Heavy TCP Host Scan%' OR i.title ILIKE '%Heavy TCP Host Scan%' OR i.description ILIKE '%Heavy TCP Host Scan%' OR i.source_ip ILIKE '%Heavy TCP Host Scan%' OR i.reporting_device ILIKE '%Heavy TCP Host Scan%' OR i.event_type ILIKE '%Heavy TCP Host Scan%' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY incident_count DESC;
live_verification_sql_queries.reconcile_target_rule_and_top50_overlap: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incidents WHERE rule_id IN ('9839fa49-40ac-4676-abcc-4c5581ae9e09', 'PH_RULE_HEAVY_TCP_HOST_SCAN')) AS fk_matched_only, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incidents WHERE rule_id IN ('9839fa49-40ac-4676-abcc-4c5581ae9e09', 'PH_RULE_HEAVY_TCP_HOST_SCAN') OR event_type = 'PH_RULE_HEAVY_TCP_HOST_SCAN') AS fk_or_event_type_matched, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT rule_id, event_type FROM incidents ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50) t WHERE t.rule_id = '9839fa49-40ac-4676-abcc-4c5581ae9e09' OR t.event_type = 'PH_RULE_HEAVY_TCP_HOST_SCAN') AS overlap_in_global_top50;
live_verification_sql_queries.reconcile_ground_truth_2_matched: SELECT i.incident_id, i.rule_id, i.event_type, i.status_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident_events ie WHERE ie.incident_id = i.id) AS event_count, gt.resolution, gt.is_ml_generated, gt.cleared_user, gt.cleared_reason, gt.cleared_time_epoch, gt.comments, inv.is_disputed FROM incidents i LEFT JOIN historical_ground_truth gt ON gt.incident_id = i.id LEFT JOIN investigations inv ON inv.incident_id = i.id WHERE i.rule_id IN ('9839fa49-40ac-4676-abcc-4c5581ae9e09', 'PH_RULE_HEAVY_TCP_HOST_SCAN') OR i.event_type = 'PH_RULE_HEAVY_TCP_HOST_SCAN' ORDER BY i.created_at DESC;
